intro: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot is an Alliance bounty contract issued by Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey. It directs young recruits to hunt down a notorious local thief who has been harassing Elwynn's farmers and merchants from a secluded shack near the vineyards.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge. Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!
But be wary, friend. Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him. He will not be an easy man to reach.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Garrick's shack? Are we finally free of that villain?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
